definitions.explanation: The side that is on the right when facing forward.

examples.japanese: {右側|みぎがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右側|みぎがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please walk on the right side of the road.

examples.japanese: {右側|みぎがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいます→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Documents are lined up on the right-side shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、{右側|みぎがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: After passing the intersection, you'll see a large park on the right side.

notes:
⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ (right) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). Used to specify the right-hand side of a road, building, body, or any spatial reference point.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右側|みぎがわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: walk on the right side
- {右側|みぎがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: move to the right side
- {右側|みぎがわ}⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧: right-side traffic
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右側|みぎがわ}: right side of the body

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{左側|ひだりがわ}→左側：22836_hidarigawa⟧: left side — the opposite direction
- ⟦{右手|みぎて}→右手：10438_migite⟧: right hand, but also used to mean "on the right" in directional contexts
- ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧: right — more general, while {右側|みぎがわ} specifically emphasizes the side

USAGE:
In Japan, pedestrians walk on the {右側|みぎがわ} of the road when there is no sidewalk, while vehicles drive on the left. This is the opposite of many other countries.
